headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 1, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save. In other action, the Minnesota Twins edged the Kansas City Royals 4-3, with Kody Clemens leading the Royals' offense with a grand slam. The Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, with Jacob Webb earning the win.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Matt Vierling has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Detroit Tigers due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 30, 2026. J.P. Crawford has also been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Seattle Mariners due to left wrist inflammation, retroactive to July 30, 2026. Other notable injuries include Cionel Pérez (left forearm strain), Shane McClanahan (left mid-back tightness), Gavin Hollowell (right shoulder inflammation), Cole Sands (right elbow strain), Jakob Junis (left adductor strain), and Jose Corniell (no specific injury mentioned).

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Minnesota Twins acquired A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick. The Detroit Tigers traded C Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for RHP Zane Barnhart. The Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe and RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for SS Angel Arredondo.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Twin Cities**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a close contest. Kody Clemens led the Royals' offense with a grand slam in the game.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with the White Sox securing the win. Trent Grisham led the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren and Shota Imanaga leading the pitching effort. Amed Rosario, Spencer Jones, and Pedro Ramírez were among the key contributors for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Tigers Place Matt Vierling on 10-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Detroit Tigers center fielder Matt Vierling has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Minter Joins Twins in Blockbuster Trade**
top_news.summary: A.J. Minter has been traded to the Minnesota Twins in exchange for SS Bruin Agbayani and 3B Billy Amick. The trade was announced on July 31, 2026.
